## Professional Summary

Hasan Cemil Acar (rentonhead) is an Art Director and Programmer who bridges the gap between design and development. He specializes in creating end-to-end digital products — from brand identity and UI/UX design to shipping native mobile apps and modern websites.

On the technical side, he builds native iOS applications with Swift and SwiftUI, web experiences with React and Next.js, robust e-commerce solutions with WordPress/WooCommerce, and custom WordPress plugins in PHP. On the creative side, he crafts visual identities and seamless UI/UX designs using Figma and Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Illustrator, After Effects).

He is based between Istanbul and Moscow, serving clients in Turkey, Russia, and worldwide. He provides documentation and communication in all three languages he speaks.

## Services Offered

### 1. iOS Mobile App Development
Native iOS applications built with Swift and SwiftUI. End-to-end development from concept and wireframing to App Store submission and ASO (App Store Optimization). Clean, scalable code architecture with a focus on performance and user experience. Clients in Istanbul, Ankara, Izmir, Moscow, St. Petersburg, and worldwide.

**Technologies**: Swift, SwiftUI, Xcode, Core Data, CloudKit, RevenueCat, App Store Connect

### 2. Modern Web Development
Fast, dynamic, and SEO-friendly websites built with modern frameworks. Server-side rendering and static generation for optimal performance. Responsive designs that work beautifully on all devices.

**Technologies**: React, Next.js, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Python, Firebase, Vercel

### 3. E-Commerce & CMS Solutions
Turnkey, affordable e-commerce stores. From theme customization to complete technical infrastructure. Payment gateway integration, inventory management, and shipping configuration.

**Technologies**: WordPress, WooCommerce, Shopify, Elementor, Rank Math

### 4. WordPress Plugin Development
Custom WordPress plugins written in PHP that extend core WordPress functionality, WooCommerce, and Elementor. Clean, maintainable, and well-documented code. Hook-based architecture following WordPress coding standards.

**Technologies**: PHP, WordPress Hooks (Actions & Filters), WordPress REST API, WooCommerce API, Elementor Widget API

### 5. UI/UX Design
Professional interface and experience design. Complete brand identity systems from logo to guidelines. Mobile and web UI design with attention to aesthetics, functionality, and accessibility.

**Tools**: Figma, Adobe Photoshop, Adobe Illustrator, Adobe After Effects

### 6. App Store Screenshot Design
Conversion-focused App Store screenshot and marketing visual design for iOS applications. Screenshots that match a brand's visual language and tell its story effectively to drive downloads.

### 7. Local & Technical SEO
Website optimization for search engines using Rank Math and best practices. Local SEO strategies for Google Maps and Yandex Maps visibility. Technical SEO audits, structured data implementation, and content strategy.

**Tools**: Rank Math, Google Search Console, Google Analytics, next-sitemap

- **Status**: Live
